name: ID Quantique
description: ID Quantique is a Swiss quantum technology company and pioneer in quantum-safe security solutions. The company develops quantum key distribution (QKD) systems, quantum random number generators (QRNG), and quantum-safe network encryption products for government, financial, and critical infrastructure customers worldwide.

products.name: Cerberis QKD System
products.description: Quantum key distribution platform for securing fiber-optic communications over metropolitan and backbone networks

products.name: Quantis QRNG
products.description: Quantum random number generators available as PCIe cards, USB devices, and chip-level modules

highlights: Founded in 2001 — one of the world's first commercial quantum technology companies
Pioneer in quantum-safe security with deployments in government and financial sectors globally
Over 100 employees and CHF 50M+ in funding — a mature, revenue-generating quantum company

news.title: IonQ Completes Acquisition of Controlling Stake in ID Quantique
news.excerpt: In 2025, IonQ announced that it had completed its acquisition of a controlling stake in ID Quantique.
